prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A production transparent VFX MATERIAL ATLAS for an isometric painterly mythological strategy game. Landscape canvas 4:3 aspect, exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows of equally sized square cells. Twelve separate non-overlapping effect textures, not an animation sequence. All backgrounds and gaps truly alpha-transparent, no black rectangles. Painterly magical effects with precise bright core, soft luminous alpha edges and restrained particles; match polished gold and deep blue fantasy game art, colored accents below. No icon frames or card backs. Each effect centered and contained in central 65% of its cell; leave at least 15% of each cell blank around it. No words or numbers or visible grid. Material order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
Cell 1: Greek royal blue and warm gold, laurel/lightning energy small radial impact burst, no dark smoke, isolated energy puff.
Cell 2: Greek royal blue and warm gold, laurel/lightning energy luminous upright domed shield membrane, hollow see-through center.
Cell 3: Greek royal blue and warm gold, laurel/lightning energy horizontal energy comet moving RIGHT, tapered trail ending on left, stays inside cell.
Cell 4: Greek royal blue and warm gold, laurel/lightning energy top-down circular luminous ground seal, hollow center, no letters, no text.
Cell 5: Norse icy cyan and silver, frost shards and rune energy small radial impact burst, no dark smoke, isolated energy puff.
Cell 6: Norse icy cyan and silver, frost shards and rune energy luminous upright domed shield membrane, hollow see-through center.
Cell 7: Norse icy cyan and silver, frost shards and rune energy horizontal energy comet moving RIGHT, tapered trail ending on left, stays inside cell.
Cell 8: Norse icy cyan and silver, frost shards and rune energy top-down circular luminous ground seal, hollow center, no letters, no text.
Cell 9: Egyptian amber and lapis, sun dust and geometric light small radial impact burst, no dark smoke, isolated energy puff.
Cell 10: Egyptian amber and lapis, sun dust and geometric light luminous upright domed shield membrane, hollow see-through center.
Cell 11: Egyptian amber and lapis, sun dust and geometric light horizontal energy comet moving RIGHT, tapered trail ending on left, stays inside cell.
Cell 12: Egyptian amber and lapis, sun dust and geometric light top-down circular luminous ground seal, hollow center, no letters, no text.
Very important: no shared lighting or connecting trails, no cropping, no sparks spilling into adjacent cells. Effects are reusable sprite textures for real-time scale/opacity animation. Render native 2048x1536 if available, otherwise largest native 4:3.
